exposure: 8 L/min bias gas flow group vs. 12 L/min bias gas flow group
Bias gas flow (8 L/min vs. 12 L/min)
outcome: Imposed inspiratory and expiratory T-piece resistance
cohort: 54 preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks gestation
finding: Using a higher bias gas flow (12 L/min) during T-piece resuscitation of preterm infants reduced imposed inspiratory and expiratory resistance but did not significantly affect the incidence of expiratory breaking maneuvers.
gest_age: Median gestational age: 29+6 weeks (28+4 - 30+3) for 12 L/min group and 28+5 weeks (25+6 - 30+3) for 8 L/min group
